name: Hornero Audio Deck
description: Audio Deck: a desktop instrument over the shared media, audio and spectrum providers: the real PipeWire spectrum as VU strips, the current track and the output volume. Real data only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: real PipeWire spectrum as phosphor VU strips, now playing and output volume over the shared providers (PluginKit 3 desktop widget).

showSpectrum.description: Show the spectrum. It holds the shared `spectrum` lease, which runs the PipeWire visualiser only while this is on and the widget is loaded.

showArtist.description: Show the artist and album line of the current track.
